title:
The {@link https://github.com/estree/estree ESTree Spec} is the most widely used JavaScript abstract syntax tree
(AST) model. It is defined as the JSON into which parsers such as **Esprima** and **Acorn** parse JavaScript source
code into.

This type is a wrapper for all the {@link EsTree.Node node types} which match the names defined in the spec:
 - {@link Estree.AnonymousDefaultExportedClassDeclaration AnonymousDefaultExportedClassDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.AnonymousDefaultExportedFunctionDeclaration AnonymousDefaultExportedFunctionDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ArrayExpression ArrayExpression} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.ArrayPattern ArrayPattern} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ArrowFunctionExpression ArrowFunctionExpression} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.AssignmentExpression AssignmentExpression} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.AssignmentOperator AssignmentOperator} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.AssignmentPattern AssignmentPattern} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.AssignmentProperty AssignmentProperty} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.AwaitExpression AwaitExpression} (ES2017)
 - {@link Estree.BinaryExpression BinaryExpression} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.BinaryOperator BinaryOperator} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.BlockStatement BlockStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.BreakStatement BreakStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.CallExpression CallExpression} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.CatchClause CatchClause} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.Class Class} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ClassBody ClassBody} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ClassDeclaration ClassDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ClassExpression ClassExpression} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ConditionalExpression ConditionalExpression} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.ContinueStatement ContinueStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.DebuggerStatement DebuggerStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.Declaration Declaration} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.Directive Directive} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.DoWhileStatement DoWhileStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.EmptyStatement EmptyStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.ExportAllDeclaration ExportAllDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ExportDefaultDeclaration ExportDefaultDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ExportNamedDeclaration ExportNamedDeclaration} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ExportSpecifier ExportSpecifier} (ES2015)

 - {@link Estree.ExpressionStatement ExpressionStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.ForInStatement ForInStatement} (ES5)
 - {@link Estree.ForOfStatement ForOfStatement} (ES2015)
 - {@link Estree.ForStatement ForStatement} (ES5)

 - {@link Estree.FunctionBody FunctionBody} (ES5)

 - {@link Estree.NewExpression NewExpression} (ES5)
